Alger, 29 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, October 29, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Ministry of Religious Affairs and Wakfs has launched a new version of its mobile application "Adhan El Djazair officiel", featuring notably a silent mode during prayer as well as a three-dimensional qibla compass. Free and ad-free, this update covers more than sixty Algerian cities according to the official calendar.
Les fonctionnalités et nouveautés de l'a: Features and new additions of the official application
Lancée mardi 27 octobre, l'application «: Launched on Tuesday, October 27, the application "Adhan El Djazair officiel" (أذان الجزائر الرسمي) succeeds a first version deployed in 2017 on Android phones. It provides the times for the five daily prayers as well as sunrise, calculated according to the official Algerian method of the ministry. The home screen features a precise countdown to the next adhan, the Hijri and Gregorian dates, as well as a weekly calendar.
Parmi les principales nouveautés figure: Among the main new features is a silent mode that activates automatically after the call to prayer for a duration chosen by the user, with a specific option for Friday prayer. However, this feature leaves alarms, the adhan, and calls from favorite contacts audible. The tool also integrates a qibla compass equipped with a three-dimensional camera view, morning and evening adhkar, a section listing religious and national holidays, a commemorative page on the history of Algeria, as well as an imsakia for Ramadan.
L'application couvre exclusivement plus: The application exclusively covers more than sixty Algerian cities and does not work for users abroad.
L'utilisateur peut personnaliser l'adhan: The user can customize the adhan by choosing among Algerian muezzins, assigning a different adhan for each prayer, or importing a file from their phone.
Un système d'alerte permet d'être préven: An alert system provides warnings between five and thirty minutes before the prayer time, with the call displaying over the lock screen.
La mise à jour corrige un bug de plantag: The update fixes a crash bug on Android and makes the triggering of the adhan more reliable, including after a phone reboot.
Les autorisations d'accès à la localisat: Location and camera access permissions are required solely for the operation of the qibla compass.
